_settings_hierarchy: Managed > CLI args > Local(.claude/settings.local.json) > Project(.claude/settings.json) > User(~/.claude/settings.json)
_description: 프로젝트 .claude/settings.json 템플릿. 필요한 훅만 활성화하여 사용.

hooks.command: if [ -f HANDOFF.md ]; then cat HANDOFF.md; fi

CMD=$(cat /dev/stdin | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '(rm\s+-rf\s+/|git\s+push\s+--force\s+(origin\s+)?(main|master)|drop\s+database|DROP\s+TABLE)'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Dangerous command blocked"}}' >&2; exit 2; fi
FILE=$(cat /dev/stdin | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if [ -n "$FILE" ] && echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|css|md|json)$'; then npx prettier --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; fi
MSG=$(cat /dev/stdin | jq -r '.message // "Task complete"'); osascript -e "display notification \"$MSG\" with title \"Claude Code\" sound name \"Glass\""
